newsitem.title: USA: Technical Chemicals gets Eckerd order.
newsitem.headline: Technical Chemicals gets Eckerd order.

text.p: Technical Chemicals & Products Inc said on Wednesday it received its first order from Eckerd Corp for its HealthCheck line of over-the-counter diagnostic products.
The order is for 6,000 units of the company's diabetes tests and 6,000 of its cholesterol tests, both intended for consumers to use at home.

Technical Chemicals said the industry estimates that the potential market for over-the-counter health monitoring products in the United States will more than double by 2000, to $2.82 billion from the current $1.23 billion.
Technical Chemicals makes in-vitro medical diagnostics products for use in doctors' offices and in the home.
